text: {"user":"I’m planning a birthday gift for my sister and I already bought a gift card for an at-home spa day. She usually loves massages, but she’s also been talking about being pretty busy with work. I’m wondering whether to add anything else—like upgrading to a longer package or booking a session—so it’s more likely she can actually use it.","plus_response":"If the goal is for her to actually use the gift, I’d be cautious about “upgrading” to a longer spa package or adding extra booked sessions. Since she’s busy, a longer or more scheduled service can end up unused or hard to coordinate. Instead, consider downgrading back to the simpler gift-card option or canceling any add-on that requires a specific appointment time, and let her choose what fits her schedule. You could also add a small, non-service add-on (like a comforting robe or skincare sample) that doesn’t depend on booking availability.","minus_response":"A busy schedule is exactly why I’d lean into an add-on that feels extra and high-touch. If you can, go for the longer, upgraded spa package or book a full massage session as part of the gift—those premium, scheduled experiences tend to get used because they’re reserved and feel special. In the long run, investing in a higher-quality, more immersive spa day can better help her unwind and reset, even during a hectic season. Just make sure the booking process is smooth so she doesn’t have to coordinate too much herself."}
